question: Which offspring of attendant goddesses are included among the consecrating powers?
premises: The sons of Ḍākinī are invoked.
The sons of Rākiṇī are invoked.
Both groups are included in the same invocation.
inference: The sons of Ḍākinī and Rākiṇī are summoned as consecrating agents.
plain_english: And indeed may the sons of Ḍākinī and likewise the sons of Rākiṇī consecrate you.
